capabilities: Color list-property values as pills with automatic, preset, and custom hex colors
Apply ordered conditional-formatting rules for text, lists, checkboxes, inputs, and numbers
Adjust Base table layout with row heights, reusable column-width presets, and header indicators
Edit filenames inline and create notes from group headings with a value pre-assigned
Manage all discovered pill colors and rules in a searchable, Base-scoped manager
extras: Not yet accepted into the Obsidian Community Plugins directory; manual installation from GitHub releases is described. The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Works entirely offline with no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian's Base tables offer no built-in way to color-code property values or apply conditional visual formatting to cells.

relations.evidence: adds compact, Notion-inspired pill colors and conditional formatting to Obsidian Base tables

summary: Adds Notion-style pill colors, conditional formatting rules, and layout controls to Obsidian Base tables.
